items.title: Sands interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: Like being in Christian McBride’s band he really taught me his way of presenting music and what he wanted

ctx.x: Oh man. A number of things. You know whether it’s I mean I’ve been playing since I was a kid so there’s a lot of those moments where you are, you know, there’s this respect

given to the band leader but you have to know about it, you have to learn about those things you know. So when you’re a child, you like to just play all the time you know. It’s like yeah, cool, and you do like eight choruses when you’re really only supposed to do one. Sometimes that can happen. And someone’s like, “No don’t do that.” Just do one chorus or two because then so-and-so can’t get their choruses in. You know or we want that song to be short, okay, let’s do a short tune. All right, cool. And you do a…
Sometimes it’s the hand motion or the look.
